mapper.sql: m.code, m.grade, m.class_no, m.name, m.college_id, m.head_teacher_id, m.status, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_by, m.update_by, m.is_deleted, c.id as c_id, c.name as college_name, c.code as college_code, c.status as college_status, t.id as t_id, t.teacher_number, t.status as teacher_status, u.id as u_id, u.real_name, u.phone, u.email
mapper.select: SELECT m.code, m.grade, m.class_no as classNo, m.name, m.college_id as collegeId, c.name as collegeName, m.head_teacher_id as headTeacherId, t.teacher_number as headTeacherNumber, u.real_name as headTeacherName, m.status, CASE WHEN m.status = 0 THEN '正常' WHEN m.status = 1 THEN '停招' WHEN m.status = 2 THEN '撤销' ELSE '未知' END as statusText, COUNT(s.id) as studentCount, m.create_time as createTime, m.create_by as createBy, m.update_time as updateTime, m.update_by as updateBy FROM majors m LEFT JOIN colleges c ON m.college_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON m.head_teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN students s ON m.code = s.major_code AND m.grade = s.grade AND m.class_no = s.class_no AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.code = #{code} AND m.grade = #{grade} AND m.class_no = #{classNo} AND m.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.code, m.grade, m.class_no
